title: Ship Hulls
description: Required design choice. The main material used in a ship's construction. Multiple hulls may be taken.

options.name: Reef-Iron
options.description: Metal plating from decommissioned ships, reshaped for the frame. Durable and rust-resistant.

options.name: Leviathan Bone
options.description: Crafted from one or more pieces of leviathan skeleton. Solid, if a little morbid.

options.name: Broadwood
options.description: Wooden planks cut from the more reliable trees of the Wildsea. Strong and flexible.

options.name: Rough Bark
options.description: Harvested from the ironroots. Irregular and tough to maintain, but easy to overlook at distance.

options.name: Chitinous
options.description: Made from collected shells of the Wildsea's larger insects. Smooth, with little friction or snags.

options.name: Razorscale
options.description: An exterior of interlocking scales sloughed or harvested from a wildsea beast, sharpened for effectiveness.

options.name: Beastback
options.description: A half-living hull of flesh and bone, flexible and unsettlingly warm.

options.name: Ceramic
options.description: A shell of heavy baked clay. Ostentatious and brittle unless very carefully maintained.

options.name: Chrysalid
options.description: A hull adapted from the cast-off chrysalis of a massive insect, excellent against the sea's incursion.

options.name: Ghost-Oak
options.description: Pale as death and remarkably flexible, rarely found growing outside the lightless depths of the drown.

options.name: Arachnesque
options.description: Less a hull and more a giant insect grown to fit the specifications of the frame, usually something spider-like.

options.name: Exile's Copper
options.description: A rare metal that weighs far less than it has any right to, prized for racing-ship hulls.

options.name: Junk-Strung
options.description: Barely a hull at all; a collection of scavenged metal, driftwood, and animal bones. Unstable, rusting, and leaky.
options.special: Mark your seals or armour rating to pull a piece of useful salvage from the hull.

options.name: Floraflage
options.description: A hull of living vegetation grown purposefully around the frame. Blends easily into the seascape.
options.special: A floraflage ship at rest is almost impossible to detect — increase impact when using stealth while motionless.

options.name: Monument
options.description: An absurd affectation made of appallingly heavy mountain-stone.
options.special: A ship with a monument hull cannot Forge Ahead during a journey.
